name: Management Accountant
responsibilities: Install or advise on systems for recording costs and other financial and budgetary data so management can actually trust the numbers
Prepare and analyze reports on financial performance and asset utilization, and recommend changes to operations based on what the numbers say
Coordinate with department heads and supervisors to keep budgetary data flowing in and get buy-in on the recommendations you make
skills: Building or advising on a costing/budgeting system, not just operating one someone else designed
Turning raw financial data into a recommendation a non-finance manager will act on
Working ERP and business intelligence software to pull and reconcile cost and budget data
Coordinating across departments so financial data actually gets reported accurately and on time
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software
Recommending operational changes from financial data
